name: Seegene, Inc.
summary: Seegene, Inc. manufactures and sells molecular diagnostics products worldwide. It offers IVD products comprising respiratory disease detection products for respiratory infections; gastrointestinal disease detection products for gastrointestinal tract infections; human papillomavirus detection products; sexually transmitted infections causative pathogens detection products; tuberculosis detection products; drug resistance products; Magicplex sepsis real-time test for the detection and identification of sepsis causing pathogens; and meningitis detection products.
